# Large construction vehicle movements on A134 from mid-September until late-October


- [Home](https://www.nationalgrid.com/)
- [The Great Grid Upgrade](https://www.nationalgrid.com/the-great-grid-upgrade)
- [Bramford to Twinstead](https://www.nationalgrid.com/the-great-grid-upgrade/bramford-to-twinstead)
- [Latest news](https://www.nationalgrid.com/the-great-grid-upgrade/bramford-to-twinstead/news)


3rd September 2026


*Bramford to Twinstead*


We're delivering construction materials to our main construction compound (north of Leavenheath) in September and October 2026. No road closures are planned as part of this work, but the delivery vehicles will be larger than normal and could therefore cause some disruption to your journey.


From Monday to Thursday between 14 September and the end of October 2026, up-to two deliveries of large construction materials from the Port of Felixstowe to our main works compound (north of Leavenheath) will take place each day. We will time the deliveries to avoid rush hour and they will not leave the port until after 9am.


The size of the materials being transported means they can't be moved using standard road vehicles and will require a police escort. We don't need any road closures for the deliveries to take place, but their size means that they may cause some congestion on the road network (particularly once they have left the A12).


Starting at the Port of Felixstowe, the delivery vehicles will travel along the A14, moving onto the A12 at J55 Copdock Interchange. The delivery vehicles will leave the A12 at J28 Colchester North interchange, connecting onto the A134 and up to our main construction compound (north of Leavenheath) via A1341 Via Urbis Romanae. You can see a map of the delivery route below.


Image


We understand that our work may cause some disruption to your journey, and we sincerely apologise for any inconvenience this may cause. Our teams will work to complete these activities as efficiently and safely as possible.
